missions.title: Calibrate your objective
missions.briefing: Your focus terminal is online. Choose one concrete task and make it visible. Let the mission begin with clarity rather than urgency.
missions.objective: Write down the one task that matters most right now.

missions.title: Cross the noise field
missions.briefing: Peripheral signals keep changing, but your selected task remains centered. Stay with the plan and let distractions pass without following them.

missions.title: Archive the mission
missions.briefing: This session is ending. Capture the result, note remaining risks, and leave a clear re-entry point for your next session.
missions.objective: Save your progress and identify the next action.
